stories.title: New Connah’s Quay power station would dominate landscape for 2.5km, Flintshire council tells inspectors
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has told planning inspectors that Uniper’s proposed new power station at Connah’s Quay would be a dominant visual feature in the surrounding landscape for up to 2.5km. stories.title: Two new industrial units approved at Rhydymwyn estate where fire destroyed building in 2022
stories.summary: A planning officer at Flintshire County Council has approved two industrial units at Antelope Industrial Estate on Denbigh Road, Rhydymwyn, three years after a fire destroyed the site’s largest building. stories.title: Zero hours workers could get guaranteed contracts — here is what the consultation proposes
